def prepare_file_hierarchy(path):
    """
    Create a temporary folder structure like the following:

        test_find_dotenv0/
        └── child1
            ├── child2
            │   └── child3
            │       └── child4
            └── .env

    """

    leaf = path / "child1" / "child2" / "child3" / "child4"
    leaf.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return leaf
